design_description: CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->SLGSADYAFD (W99S G100L D102S G103A F104D M107F). RFD4-Proteina generative design, novelty-filtered against 525063 known CDRH3s. Retains the Lys593 interface H-bond best of all candidates (2.51A in a template-guided Boltz-2 refold vs 2.63A for a wild-type control). Predicted binding ddG 0.42 kcal/mol. Fewest developability liabilities of any candidate (5 vs 8 for trastuzumab).

CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGRGPYWMD (D102R F104P A106W). Enumerated over the six CDRH3 positions that make no HER2 contact, keeping W99/G103/Y105. Best predicted binding ddG of the submitted set, 0.20+-0.16 kcal/mol (statistically indistinguishable from wild-type). Epitope recall 4/4; Lys593 H-bond retained at 3.48A.

CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGGMGPYWMD (D102M F104P A106W) plus framework S85N R87T. Same CDRH3 core as our CDRH3-only candidates, so the framework pair is the only added variable: this row is a controlled test of a thermostability hypothesis (Ng et al.), not an independent design. The framework pair creates an N-glycosylation sequon NLT at VH85-87; we measured that site 21.1 A from the nearest HER2 atom and 19.4 A from the nearest light-chain atom, so a glycan cannot reach either interface. No measured Tm or affinity, and the benefit is glycosylation-dependent and unconfirmed for the expression system. Predicted epitope contacts retained in 3/3 Boltz-2 diffusion samples sharing one seed and MSA, so correlated.

CDRH3 WGGDGFYAMD->WGHDGPYWMD (G101H F104P A106W). Same enumeration strategy. Highest predicted probability of improving on trastuzumab from our sequence model (0.244). Epitope recall 4/4; Lys593 H-bond 4.07A; predicted binding ddG 0.50 kcal/mol.
